meta.title: IP / Subnet Calculator - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Calculate network address, broadcast, subnet mask, and host range for any IP/CIDR.
alreadyOptimized: This image is already highly optimized. Try lowering the quality slider for a smaller result.
steps_ip-calculator_1Desc: Type an IP address with CIDR notation (e.g., 192.168.1.0/24) or with a subnet mask. The calculator auto-detects the input format.
steps_ip-calculator_2Desc: See network address, broadcast address, usable host range, total hosts, subnet mask, and wildcard mask — all calculated instantly.
steps_ip-calculator_3Desc: Click any field to copy it. Essential for network engineers, sysadmins, DevOps, and anyone configuring firewalls, routing, or VLANs.
